note.question: How can scalable rejection sampling support bayesian hierarchical models?
note.overview: Bayesian hierarchical modeling is a popular approach to capturing unobserved heterogeneity across individual units. However, standard estimation methods such as Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) can be impracticable for modeling outcomes from a large number of units. The paper develops a new method to sample from posterior distributions of Bayesian models, without using MCMC.
